svg.text: A / B / C type cars, drawn as the game builds them
Each car is a rounded-roof cross-section extruded along the run. Sheet 05 gives the numbers; this is the shape the player actually sees arrive.
3.0 m wide x 3.8 m tall x 22.0 m long
6 - 8 cars per consist | 5 doors / side @ 1.4 m

4 - 6 cars per consist | 4 doors / side @ 1.3 m

4 - 6 cars per consist | 4 doors / side @ 1.2 m
third rail 750 V DC / linear motor
the full 6-car consist, cab at each end
6 x 19.5 m + 5 gaps = 119.8 m of train. The platform must be at least that long, plus a stopping margin.
car at the platform, PSD closed, third rail live
PSD adds a fixed per-door transfer cost: boarding is a door, a leaf and a threshold, not one motion.
the choice decides tunnel or viaduct
A player can lay a catenary viaduct over the street and run a third-rail line under it in the same station.
